task.title: P6-093: [parked] Fractional sibling position can collide or exhaust f64 precision
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Parked — real, deliberately deferred; do not work until its trigger fires). Original id: P6-093. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/collection-api.md.

**Fractional sibling `position` can collide or exhaust precision.** `plan_drop` (`tree_manage.rs:988-1029`) still drops the moved node at the `(a + b) / 2.0` midpoint with no collision check, and no renumber or rebalance exists anywhere. Repeated inserts between one pair, or an existing tie, produce a position equal to a neighbor's, so `ORDER BY position, name` falls back to name and the node lands off from where it was dropped. Unreachable at POC scale — integer seed positions, ~50 midpoint inserts between one pair to exhaust f64.

**Trigger: an observed position collision in real data, or any ingestion path that seeds fractional rather than integer positions.** Fix by renumbering a sibling group to evenly-spaced integers when a midpoint gets too close.
